title: Reality of Vote Chori | BJP Stealing Votes?
description:
Every election, the same allegation comes up — “Vote chori” (vote theft). Rahul Gandhi blames the Election Commission of India, the ECI claims everything is fair, and the public is left confused. But the truth is more complicated.

In this video, we break down why Rahul Gandhi’s accusations don’t add up, and why the ECI’s clean chit isn’t convincing either. From EVM controversies to voter roll manipulation and weak transparency, both sides are twisting the narrative.

The real question is: if democracy is about trust, why does India keep doubting its own elections?
